notes.title: "The Safety Build"
notes.content:
Hey Players! As we fast approach the official launch for No Strings Attached, we present The Safety Build! This build includes a lot of bug fixes and some other fun additions:

[list]
[*] [b]Sound Implementation[/b]: From the creaks of Pavo moving around to the ominous tracks that play when the Puppet Master is near, these sounds will help immerse you into Pavo's world!

[*] [b]More Bug Fixes[/b]: We have been bug squashing like crazy these past weeks and have fixed numerous bugs in the game like a bug that prevented Pavo from pushing blocks in certain cases!
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this new build and look forward to the game's official exit from Early Access in early May!

notes.title: "The GDC Build"
notes.content:
Hey players! We have been hard at work getting this build ready for the upcoming GDC! We value the feedback we've gotten from the initial release of the Alpha Build as we continue making No Strings Attached. Seeing people interact with our game helps us know where to polish and fix the game. Thank you!


We are proud to present [b]The GDC Build[/b]! This build has numerous bug fixes and some major new content for players to experience.

[list]
[*] [b]New Final Level added:[/b] After finishing the Workshop level, you will find yourself in a new location, The Circus and underneath its Bleachers.

[*] [b]Additional Sound:[/b] Some sound effects and ambiance are added, though we are still working on implementation in some areas.

[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] A lot of bugs have been fixed in the first level, which we hope helps with your experience playing.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this new build and please continue to give us feedback! We are looking forward to No Strings Attached's launch in early May.
